PCB manuf. text (date code of ''1251'', Dec. 2012) is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos. A MAC label affixed to the Ethernet ports indicates usage of a 00:25:9C OUI, which seems unlikely. This device has a single USB 3.0 port and a single USB 2.0 port. Configuration with ''Belkin-Linksys'''s utility may confer a [[Cisco Connect SSIDs|SSID pattern typical of the ''Cisco Connect'' software]]. {{WiFiCert|WFA20250|07/03/2013}} ===Additional specifications=== per [[Linksys]] manual *Dimensions: [[Dimensions::256 mm x 40 mm x 184 mm]] *Weight: [[Weight::501 g]] Power supplies shown in the FCC external photos are... *'''Solytech Enterprise Corporation''' CAD4212 [CAD4212CW-1] (NEMA 1-15P plug) **100-240VAC ~ 50-60 Hz, 1.5A -> 12VDC, 3.5A *'''Solytech Enterprise Corporation''' CAD4212L [CAD4212LW-1] (Euro plug) **100-240VAC ~ 50-60 Hz, 1.5A -> 12VDC, 3.5A *''unbranded'' MU42-1120350-A1 (NEMA 1-15P) **100-240VAC ~ 50-60 Hz, 1.5A -> 12VDC, 3.5A *''unbranded'' IU42-1120350-WP (Euro plug) **100-240VAC ~ 50-60 Hz, 1.5A -> 12VDC, 3.5A ==Flashing== {{Flashnotice}} ===Flashing dd-wrt=== {{DDWRT |techdata = |wikipage = |forumpage = |github = |target = |subtarget = |arch = |support_commit_id = |support_started_version = ? |current_supported_version = ? |unsupportedfuncntions = |lan_hardware = |lan_comment = |wlan_hardware = |wlan_comment = |usb_sata_comment = |inst_method = |inst_comment = |rec_method = |rec_comment = |comment = }} Please insert instructions here ===Flashing OpenWrt=== {{OpenWrt |techdata = https://openwrt.org/toh/hwdata/linksys/linksys_ea6500_v2 |wikipage = https://openwrt.org/toh/linksys/ea6500_v2 |forumpage = https://forum.openwrt.org/viewtopic.php?id=44218 |github = |target = bcm53xx |subtarget = generic |arch = arm_cortex-a9 |support_commit_id = 53be2d2a4eaba78c1f2053589f16cf95ae9c5dd1 |support_started_version = 19.07.0 |current_supported_version = 24.10.4 |last_supported_version = |image_too_big = |unsupportedfuncntions = |lan_hardware = Broadcom BCM4708A0 |lan_comment = |wlan_hardware = Broadcom BCM4331, Broadcom BCM4360 |wlan_comment = |usb_sata_comment = |inst_method = unknown |inst_comment = |rec_method = |rec_comment = |comment = }} {{SCollapse | git • >> |
